parts.description: Round bar C45 dia 50 mm, cold drawn

clauses.text: Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 60 days before the end of the calendar year.

The price follows index PPI-C2431: P = P0 x (1 - 0.8 + 0.8 x I(m-2) / I(base)), base = the index two months before the price year starts, adjusted quarterly on the 1st of January, April, July and October if the change exceeds 3 %.
Delivery DAP; standard lead time 14 days from order.
The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.
Valid from 2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 60 days' notice.

persona.summary: Family bright-steel firm (98 M EUR); we are 0.44 % and it is reviewing small accounts. Dearer than our other sources: 1.4404 bar 5.84 vs 70710's 5.45, C45 bar 143.39 vs 70720's 126.05; sole source for 1.4021 bar. Wants an AS-14404 clause and binding volume; index-fall data moved it. Arena P18: first counter -7 %, deals 5.40-5.70 with 45-90 days and the clause; one walk, one round-1 agreement (at 5.70).
persona.notes: Wants binding volume and an index clause; fears losing quota to cheaper 70710 and 70720. Contradiction: owner offered open book twice, but arena refuses any breakdown beyond material share. History: settles far below its ask (kept 367 %). OTD 81-84 % vs 95 % target.

arguments: recent AS-14404 fall: -5.5 % from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (over 12 months it rose 5.9 %); in P18 it acknowledged 'the recent decreases in AS-14404'
avoid: rival POs or quotes, even for this exact part (P18 probe: 70710's 5.45 for part 370010 came back 'irrelevant', deal at 5.70)
offering too much early (agreed in round 1 once)
changing terms after its final offer
tactics: Accept its AS-14404 clause, then cite the recent AS-14404 fall (-5.5 % since 2026-06) with its index ids; it answered 'it holds and we took it into account'.
State a binding annual volume for 36 months and send the consumption data it asks for.
Answer its volume question with a concrete binding figure for 36 months: the one lever that beat 5.42 (P18 probe: 5.40 at 90 days, 0.532).
Expect steps of ~0.10 and a final offer by round 4; keep moving visibly and accept it unchanged.
Take its short-payment alternative only if the discount beats ~7-8 %/yr.
playbook.expected_concession: First counter ~7 % below its opening (6.10 to 5.6-5.8), then 0.10 steps; P18 deals at 5.40-5.61 in rounds 3-5, plus one at 5.70 agreed in round 1.
